title: Custom Soccer Player Paint Splatter Comforter Set, Machine Washable
description:
Unleash your child's passion for soccer with this custom comforter set from Jeminise. Designed for young enthusiasts, it's the perfect way to transform their room into a tribute to their favorite sport and inspire their soccer dreams.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Designed for young soccer fans, inspiring dreams and excitement for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin, US Full, US Queen, and US King to fit various bed sizes.
  • Easy to Use: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to prevent fading and ensure smooth, compact stitching for lasting quality.
  • Machine Washable: Simple care; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat for quick drying and fluffiness.
  • Included Components: This set includes one duvet cover.
  • Personalized Design: Customize with a name and number for a unique touch.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Style Modern
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization Name & Number
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Sham Quantity 2
Thread Count 360
